# The notifier refuses the first notice. A request that nobody heard of would expire with no one asked, so the run holds the item,
# and the ledger shows the failed notice. Nothing is approved and nothing is closed.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:ssh-keygen] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
[!exec:flock] skip
[!exec:git] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

approvalsinit
approvalsfakes
approvalskeys ann
subst home/.approval/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env APPROVALS_DIR=$WORK/ops
env APPROVALS_WINDOW_SECONDS=300
env APPROVAL_POLL=1

exec sh ops/scripts/submit.sh msa msa.md ann
exec obeereal item add approvals req-1 --title 'Release' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run req-1 approvals --workflow ops/workflow.star
stdout 'item req-1 finished'

! exists notices.log
exec sh -c 'sh ops/scripts/audit.sh req-1 - $(sqlite3 home/.approval/ledger.db "SELECT seq || \":\" || row_hash FROM events ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1")'
stdout '\tnotify-failed\t'
! stdout '\tclosed\t'
exec sqlite3 state/local.db 'SELECT state FROM items WHERE id = "req-1"'
stdout '^hold$'

-- body.txt --
{"doc":"msa","kind":"release","author":"ann"}
-- msa.md --
The release candidate.
-- home/.approval/config --
NOTIFY_API=http://notify.test
-- home/.approval/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_messages.fail --
fail
